# nlp-project

> AI CV Analyzer built with Python, Flask and NLP. Dual-method PDF extraction with Unicode normalization, spaCy NER and semantic analysis, a 5-category score from 0 to 100, personalized recommendations, YouTube learning suggestions for weak areas, and an admin dashboard with CSV export. MySQL via SQLAlchemy.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/puIad/nlp-project/blob/master/README.md): features, stack and setup

## Source

- [app/services](https://github.com/puIad/nlp-project/tree/master/app/services): extraction, NLP analysis, scoring
- [app/routes](https://github.com/puIad/nlp-project/tree/master/app/routes): Flask routes
- [run.py](https://github.com/puIad/nlp-project/blob/master/run.py): app entry point
- [create_db.py](https://github.com/puIad/nlp-project/blob/master/create_db.py): database setup
- [config.py](https://github.com/puIad/nlp-project/blob/master/config.py): configuration
